title: Alliance Rupture and Repair in Simulating Cognitive Behavioral Therapy Dialogues
abstract: arXiv:2611.27544v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT), routine work can strain the client-counselor working alliance, and the counselor must then notice the rupture, repair it, and adapt the work that follows. Existing CBT simulators model client resistance and follow structured treatment plans, but rarely track alliance state or allow counselors to repair ruptures over multiple turns and revise their plans accordingly. We present ALLY, a simulation framework that brings alliance rupture, repair, and replanning into ongoing CBT dialogue. Each client has a hidden alliance state that governs how openly the client engages. Like a real counselor, the counselor agent sees only the dialogue. It must notice when the client pulls back or pushes against the work, repair the rupture, and replan the rest of the session around what it has learned. Automatic evaluation shows that ALLY's counselors are closer to real CBT counselors than those of existing public synth

translated_title: 模拟认知行为治疗对话中的治疗联盟破裂与修复
translated_abstract: 在认知行为治疗（CBT）中，常规治疗工作可能会使来访者与咨询师之间的工作联盟变得紧张，此时咨询师必须察觉联盟的破裂，对其进行修复，并调整后续的治疗工作。现有的CBT模拟器虽然能够模拟来访者的阻抗行为并遵循结构化的治疗计划，但很少追踪联盟状态，也不允许咨询师在多轮对话中修复破裂并据此调整计划。我们提出了ALLY，一个将联盟破裂、修复和重新规划引入持续进行的CBT对话的模拟框架。每个来访者都拥有一个隐藏的联盟状态，该状态决定了来访者参与治疗的开放程度。与真实咨询师一样，咨询师智能体只能看到对话内容，它必须察觉来访者何时退缩或对治疗工作产生抵触，修复联盟的破裂，并根据所获得的信息重新规划会谈的其余部分。自动评估表明，ALLY的咨询师比现有公开的合成对话系统中的咨询师更接近真实的CBT咨询师。
tldr: 该论文提出ALLY模拟框架，首次将治疗联盟的破裂、修复与治疗计划的动态调整引入认知行为治疗对话模拟，使模拟咨询师能够像真实咨询师一样在多轮对话中察觉并修复联盟破裂。
en_tdlr: This paper presents ALLY, a simulation framework that for the first time incorporates alliance rupture, repair, and replanning into simulated CBT dialogues, enabling counselor agents to detect and repair ruptures over multiple turns like real counselors.
